title: Canonical completed tensor comparison has the strict Roos model
statement: Fix the same coefficient and scheme data and normalized completion reindexing D as in [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]. For any PodCompletedTensorReindex T of [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], suppose its forward generator law, strict-tower naturality, and Canonical equation of [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization] hold. Then its Model equation holds: on every pair of complete constructible good representatives, T.tensor realizes D.roos followed by the Roos image of T.tower, conjugated by the specified localization and completed tensor comparisons. No existence of T or of its strict towers is asserted here.

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorRoosNormalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hgen : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Generators l E g D T)
    (hnat : PodCompletedTensorReindex.TowerNaturality l E g D T)
    (hcanonical : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Canonical l E g D T) :
    PodCompletedTensorReindex.Model l E g D T
